objects.description: Something that content can be grounded in — a published text, a ruling, a standard, a dataset, a page on the web. It is the thing a reader is pointed at when a passage says where it came from. A source is described here; its full text, if held at all, lives in chunks beside it or in whichever module stores the file.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written; a create request that carries one has it ignored.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What the source is called, the way a reader would recognise it in a list. The one thing a source cannot be filed without.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What sort of source this is, in the mounting domain's own words. Deliberately not a closed set: the words differ completely from one domain to the next, and a domain that needs to filter on them declares an index.

fields.name: citation
fields.description: The formal reference a reader would write down to find the source again, in whatever citation style the domain uses. Free text, because the styles are the domain's and not this module's.

fields.name: locator
fields.description: Where the source can be reached: a web address, a shelf mark, a register number. Empty when the only copy is the one held in chunks.

fields.name: content_ref
fields.description: Where a stored copy of the source lives in another module, as that module identifies it — a file, a commit, a blob. Empty when no copy is held.

fields.name: issued_on
fields.description: When the source was issued, published or came into effect, as the source itself states it. Free text, because some sources give only a year.

fields.name: properties
fields.description: The domain's own facts about the source — who holds the rights to it, under what licence it may be used, which jurisdiction it applies in, how confidential it is. A document, so a domain adds what it needs without this module learning the words; a domain that filters on one declares an index by path.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who filed the source, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the source was filed.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the source's description last changed.

indexes.name: created
indexes.description: The newest-first ordering every listing uses.

objects.description: A link from a passage of content to the source it rests on. The content lives in another module; the annotation records which part of it, which source, and what the reader should take from the connection.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: The source the passage rests on. Required, and it must already exist.

fields.name: target_module
fields.description: Which module holds the annotated content, as the mounting host names its modules.

fields.name: target_id
fields.description: The annotated content, as the module holding it identifies it.

fields.name: anchor
fields.description: Which part of the content the annotation is about — a character range, a heading path, a numbered paragraph. A document, because each holding module points inside its content differently. Empty when the annotation is about the whole item.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: The words of the source being relied on, copied so a reader can check them without opening it.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the reader should take from the connection — why this source supports, qualifies or contradicts the passage.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who made the annotation, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the annotation was made.

indexes.name: target
indexes.description: Reading every annotation on one item of content, which is how a screen showing that item lays out its references.

indexes.name: source
indexes.description: Finding everything that rests on one source, which is what a reader needs when that source is withdrawn or overruled.

objects.description: Someone standing behind a source or an annotation — or declining to. Append-only: the most recent one is the current state, and the earlier ones are the record of how it got there.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: subject_role
fields.description: Whether a source or an annotation is being vouched for.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The source or annotation being vouched for. Required, and it must already exist.

fields.name: status
fields.description: What the verifier is saying: that it holds, that it does not, or that an earlier word of theirs no longer stands.

fields.name: verified_by
fields.description: Who vouched, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: verifier_name
fields.description: The verifier's name as it stood when they vouched, filled in by the mount's profile lookup. Kept so the record still reads correctly after a name changes.

fields.name: verifier_role
fields.description: The role the verifier held when they vouched, filled in by the mount's profile lookup. Kept because whether a word counts often depends on the role behind it, and roles change.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the verifier checked, or why they dispute it.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the verifier vouched. The latest one is the current state.

indexes.name: subject
indexes.description: Reading the history of one source or annotation, newest first.

objects.description: One passage of a source's text, held so it can be found by meaning and handed to whoever is writing with it. A retrieval result is always a chunk with its source, so whatever is written from it can say where it came from.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: The source this passage is from. Required, and it must already exist.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Where the passage falls in the source, counting from zero, so passages read back in order.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The passage itself.

fields.name: embedding
fields.description: The passage as a vector of numbers, produced by whoever filed it. Searching compares a query's vector with this one, so every chunk searched together must come from the same model.

fields.name: embedding_model
fields.description: Which model produced the vector. A search only compares chunks whose model matches the query's.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the passage was filed.

indexes.name: source
indexes.description: Reading one source's passages in order.

indexes.name: model
indexes.description: Narrowing a search to the chunks one model produced.
